WITH weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_week_end_date,
    p.category,
    SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-06-07' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_week_end_date, p.category
)
SELECT 
  p.category,
  SUM(sw.closing_units) as closing_units,
  AVG(ws.units_sold) as avg_weekly_units_sold,
  ROUND(SUM(sw.closing_units) / NULLIF(AVG(ws.units_sold), 0), 2) as weeks_of_cover
FROM fact_stock_week sw
JOIN dim_product p ON sw.product_key = p.product_key
LEFT JOIN weekly_sales ws ON p.category = ws.category
WHERE sw.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

WITH weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_week_end_date,
    p.category,
    SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-06-07' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_week_end_date, p.category
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    category,
    AVG(units_sold) as avg_weekly_units_sold,
    COUNT(*) as weeks_in_sample
  FROM weekly_sales
  GROUP BY category
),
stock_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    p.category,
    SUM(sw.closing_units) as closing_units
  FROM fact_stock_week sw
  JOIN dim_product p ON sw.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE sw.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT 
  s.category,
  s.closing_units,
  ROUND(a.avg_weekly_units_sold, 1) as avg_weekly_units_sold,
  a.weeks_in_sample,
  ROUND(s.closing_units / NULLIF(a.avg_weekly_units_sold, 0), 2) as weeks_of_cover
FROM stock_by_category s
LEFT JOIN avg_sales a ON s.category = a.category
ORDER BY s.category

WITH weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_week_end_date,
    p.category,
    SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE f.sale_date >= '2026-06-07' AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_week_end_date, p.category
),
avg_sales_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    category,
    AVG(units_sold) as avg_weekly_units_sold
  FROM weekly_sales
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT 
  p.category,
  ROUND(SUM(sw.closing_units) / NULLIF(a.avg_weekly_units_sold, 0), 2) as weeks_of_cover
FROM fact_stock_week sw
JOIN dim_product p ON sw.product_key = p.product_key
LEFT JOIN avg_sales_by_category a ON p.category = a.category
WHERE sw.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY p.category, a.avg_weekly_units_sold
ORDER BY p.category
